+const { chromium } = require('playwright-core')
+
+const URL = 'http://localhost:9347/'
+const OUT = __dirname + '/shots/'
+const errors = []
+const seed = (cityIds, extra = {}) =>
+  JSON.stringify({
+    state: { cityIds, mode: 'meeting', settings: { wakeHour: 7, sleepHour: 23, timeFormat: '12h' }, ...extra },
+    version: 1,
+  })
+const MANY = ['san-francisco', 'denpasar', 'geneva', 'kathmandu', 'johannesburg', 'sao-paulo', 'auckland', 'tehran']
+
+async function open(browser, viewport, opts = {}) {
+  const ctx = await browser.newContext({ viewport, deviceScaleFactor: 2, ...opts })
+  const page = await ctx.newPage()
+  page.on('console', (m) => m.type() === 'error' && errors.push(m.text()))
+  page.on('pageerror', (e) => errors.push(String(e)))
+  return { ctx, page }
+}
+
+async function run() {
+  const browser = await chromium.launch({ channel: 'chrome' })
+
+  // Remove every city through the UI -> single-city prompt -> empty state -> add via empty state
+  {
+    const { ctx, page } = await open(browser, { width: 1280, height: 900 })
+    await page.goto(URL)
+    await page.waitForSelector('[role="table"]')
+    await page.click('button[aria-label="Remove Geneva"]')
+    await page.click('button[aria-label="Remove Denpasar"]')
+    await page.waitForTimeout(400)
+    console.log('one city summary:', (await page.textContent('section[aria-label="Overlap summary"]')).replace(/\s+/g, ' '))
+    console.log('one city overlap cells:', await page.$$eval('[data-state="overlap"]', (e) => e.length))
+    await page.screenshot({ path: OUT + 'a1-one-city.png', fullPage: true })
+    await page.click('button[aria-label="Remove San Francisco"]')
+    await page.waitForTimeout(400)
+    console.log('empty state:', (await page.textContent('main')).includes('No cities yet'))
+    await page.screenshot({ path: OUT + 'a2-empty.png', fullPage: true })
+    await page.click('button:has-text("Add a city")')
+    await page.fill('[cmdk-input]', 'tok')
+    await page.keyboard.press('Enter')
+    await page.waitForTimeout(400)
+    console.log('after empty add:', await page.$$eval('[role="rowheader"]', (e) => e.map((x) => x.innerText.split('\n')[0])))
+
+    // keyboard: mode switch arrows
+    await page.focus('role=radio[name="Meeting"]')
+    await page.keyboard.press('ArrowRight')
+    console.log('arrow -> base checked:', await page.getAttribute('role=radio[name="Base"]', 'aria-checked'))
+
+    // cross-tab sync
+    const other = await ctx.newPage()
+    await other.goto(URL)
+    await other.waitForSelector('[role="table"]')
+    await page.click('button:has-text("Add city")')
+    await page.fill('[cmdk-input]', 'paris')
+    await page.keyboard.press('Enter')
+    await page.waitForTimeout(600)
+    console.log('other tab rows:', await other.$$eval('[role="rowheader"]', (e) => e.map((x) => x.innerText.split('\n')[0])))
+    await ctx.close()
+  }
+
+  // Many cities, mobile
+  {
+    const { ctx, page } = await open(browser, { width: 390, height: 844 }, { deviceScaleFactor: 3, isMobile: true, hasTouch: true })
+    await page.goto(URL)
+    await page.evaluate((s) => localStorage.setItem('tz-overlap', s), seed(MANY))
+    await page.reload()
+    await page.waitForSelector('[role="table"]')
+    const clipped = await page.$$eval('[data-hour]', (els) => els.filter((e) => e.scrollWidth > e.clientWidth + 1).length)
+    console.log('mobile 8 cities clipped cells:', clipped, 'doc width:', await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth))
+    const headerClip = await page.$$eval('[role="columnheader"]', (els) => els.filter((e) => e.scrollWidth > e.clientWidth + 1).length)
+    console.log('mobile 8 cities clipped headers:', headerClip)
+    await page.screenshot({ path: OUT + 'a3-mobile-many.png', fullPage: false })
+    await page.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo(0, 700))
+    await page.screenshot({ path: OUT + 'a4-mobile-many-scrolled.png', fullPage: false })
+    await ctx.close()
+  }
+
+  // Many cities, 1024 desktop + touch tablet 820
+  {
+    const { ctx, page } = await open(browser, { width: 1024, height: 900 })
+    await page.goto(URL)
+    await page.evaluate((s) => localStorage.setItem('tz-overlap', s), seed(MANY, { mode: 'base' }))
+    await page.reload()
+    await page.waitForSelector('[role="table"]')
+    const clipped = await page.$$eval('[data-hour]', (els) => els.filter((e) => e.scrollWidth > e.clientWidth + 1).length)
+    console.log('1024 base 8 cities clipped:', clipped)
+    await page.screenshot({ path: OUT + 'a5-1024-many-base.png', fullPage: true })
+    await ctx.close()
+
+    const t = await open(browser, { width: 820, height: 1180 }, { hasTouch: true, isMobile: true })
+    await t.page.goto(URL)
+    await t.page.waitForSelector('[role="table"]')
+    console.log('tablet remove opacity:', await t.page.$eval('button[aria-label="Remove Geneva"]', (e) => getComputedStyle(e).opacity))
+    console.log('tablet hint:', await t.page.textContent('footer p'))
+    await t.page.screenshot({ path: OUT + 'a6-tablet-touch.png', fullPage: true })
+    await t.ctx.close()
+  }
+
+  console.log('errors:', errors)
+  await browser.close()
+}
+
+run().catch((e) => {
+  console.error('FAILED', e)
+  process.exit(1)
+})

import { create } from 'zustand'
import { createJSONStorage, persist } from 'zustand/middleware'
import { CITY_BY_ID } from '../domain/cities'
import type { Mode } from '../domain/schedule'
import { createDefaultState, DEFAULT_SETTINGS, sanitizeState, type PersistedState, type Settings } from './persisted'

interface Actions {
  addCity: (id: string) => void
  removeCity: (id: string) => void
  makeReference: (id: string) => void
  setMode: (mode: Mode) => void
  updateSettings: (patch: Partial<Settings>) => void
  resetSettings: () => void
}

export type AppState = PersistedState & Actions

export const useAppStore = create<AppState>()(
  persist(
    (set) => ({
      ...createDefaultState(),

      addCity: (id) =>
        set((s) => (CITY_BY_ID.has(id) && !s.cityIds.includes(id) ? { cityIds: [...s.cityIds, id] } : s)),

      removeCity: (id) => set((s) => ({ cityIds: s.cityIds.filter((cityId) => cityId !== id) })),

      makeReference: (id) =>
        set((s) => (s.cityIds.includes(id) ? { cityIds: [id, ...s.cityIds.filter((cityId) => cityId !== id)] } : s)),

      setMode: (mode) => set({ mode }),

      updateSettings: (patch) => set((s) => ({ settings: { ...s.settings, ...patch } })),

      resetSettings: () => set({ settings: { ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS } }),
    }),
    {
      name: 'tz-overlap',
      version: 1,
      storage: createJSONStorage(() => localStorage),
      partialize: ({ cityIds, mode, settings }): PersistedState => ({ cityIds, mode, settings }),
      migrate: (persisted) => sanitizeState(persisted),
      merge: (persisted, current) => ({ ...current, ...sanitizeState(persisted) }),
    },
  ),
)

# Timezone overlap checker

Find the hours when everyone across a set of cities is awake, or compare one base city against each colleague individually.

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm dev        # http://localhost:9347
```

| Script           | What it does                         |
| ---------------- | ------------------------------------ |
| `pnpm dev`       | Vite dev server on port 9347         |
| `pnpm build`     | Type-check and production build      |
| `pnpm preview`   | Serve the production build on 9347   |
| `pnpm test`      | Unit tests for the scheduling logic  |
| `pnpm lint`      | ESLint (TypeScript + React hooks)    |
| `pnpm typecheck` | `tsc -b`                             |

## How it works

- **Meeting mode** highlights the hours when every city is awake. **Base mode** compares the reference city with each other city on its own; the reference row lights up wherever at least one city overlaps.
- The first city is the reference: each of the 24 columns is one hour of its day, and every cell shows the local time in that city at that moment. Click a city name to promote it.
- UTC offsets are read from `Intl` for the current instant, so DST and fractional zones (India +5:30, Nepal +5:45, Iran +3:30) are exact. The date rolls over at local midnight, marked with the weekday.
- Overlap windows are inclusive start, exclusive end, and wrap across midnight (22:00–02:00 is one window, not two).
- When nobody-left-out is impossible, the summary suggests the closest compromise and who would be asleep.
- Cities, mode and awake window persist to `localStorage` (`tz-overlap`) and are sanitised on load.

## Structure

```
src/
  domain/      pure logic: city catalog, timezone math, overlap analysis, share text (unit-tested)
  state/       zustand stores: persisted app state + ephemeral UI focus
  hooks/       useSchedule (view model), useNow (minute ticker), useMediaQuery
  components/
    grid/      DesktopGrid (cities as rows) and MobileGrid (cities as columns), shared HourCell
    summary/   OverlapSummary, RangeBadge, CopyButton
    ui/        Button, Segmented, Kbd
```

Stack: React 19, Vite 8, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4, zustand, Radix Popover, cmdk. Reordering animations use the native View Transitions API.

The final pass is done. I found and fixed one real bug, a layout regression on phones with nine or more cities, and a handful of polish issues. Typecheck, lint, 34 unit tests and the production build all pass. The JS bundle is 121 KB gzipped.

**Bug: the "no overlap" fallback listed the wrong people.** When no hour works for everyone, the summary suggests the closest windows and says who'd be asleep. It merged neighbouring best hours even when different cities were asleep in each, then listed everyone asleep at any point. With 12 cities it said "9 of 12 awake" and named 5 sleepers. Windows now split wherever the set of sleepers changes, so each one's list is exact for every hour it covers. The fix is in `meetingFallback` in `schedule.ts`, with a regression test.

**Phones with many cities.** With 8 cities, 17 cells and 2 headers were clipped, and names broke mid-word ("Denp/asar").
- From 5 cities, column headers switch to a compact layout: the city code (SFO, DPS, KTM), the offset from the reference city, and a stacked UTC offset. Cells stack hour over am/pm. Screen readers and the hover tooltip still get the full city name. I added an IATA `code` to each city, and codes are searchable too ("jnb" finds Johannesburg).
- From 9 cities, the grid scrolls sideways. The first version lost the pinned city header, so the header now sits outside the scrolling area and follows its horizontal position. At 12 cities the header stays pinned with zero column drift, and the page itself never gets wider than the screen.
- With 4 or fewer cities, full names still show and now hyphenate instead of breaking mid-word.

**Other fixes:**
- **Tabs stay in sync.** Before, two open tabs silently overwrote each other's changes. A `storage` listener in `app-store.ts` now reloads state when another tab writes.
- **Remove buttons on touch.** They were dimmed to 45% on tablets, which can't hover to reveal them. They now dim only on devices that can hover, via a `.row-action` rule in `styles.css`.
- **No highlight flashes while scrolling.** Touch no longer triggers the hover highlight on the grid.
- **Faster cells.** Grid cells now skip re-rendering on the per-minute clock tick.
- **Readability.** Times in sleeping cells were hard to read, so I darkened them a little.
- **Small fixes.** The settings labels now say "Wake-up hour" and "Sleep hour" as the spec asks, and the line under the reference row only appears when there's a second row.
- **README.** It now mentions tab sync and the compact phone layout.

I checked in Chrome on port 9347 at 390px (5, 8 and 12 cities), 820px touch tablet, 1024px and 1280px, including the empty and one-city states, the keyboard mode switch and two-tab sync. There were no console errors. Afterwards I removed `playwright-core` and the audit script and screenshots, and stopped the dev server; port 9347 is free.
